# Roleplay Rule 17 - Self-antag
Self-antagging is when a player decides they will be an antag despite the game stating you are a crew member or non-antagonist. Self-Antag is not allowed on Goobstation.
Exceptions to this rule exist. There are looser restrictions around roles such as the Clown and Mime where they may act out or bother the station enough to be arrested, however they are not allowed to act as a full fledged antag. These roles are intended to be humorous, not purely detrimental..
This also may apply to a degree to ‘tiding’. Tiding is a “lifestyle” assistant players have decided to identify and often comes with petty crimes such as trespassing or stealing. Goob’s stance on this may change in the future but consider the following:
- If you decide to ‘tide’ you will be scrutinised by the admins, habitual tiding will tarnish your reputation if it’s seen as a nuance more than it is funny - Admins at any point may decide you’ve had enough and should stop. - Departments reserve the right to defend themselves and their resources in lieu of tiding. (More info Roleplay Rule 2 - Escalation and roleplay.)
